script_text: Stop! Aries, Saturn just crashed into your sign at zero degrees and nothing will ever be the same. As of today, Saturn conjuncts your Sun in your 1st House of Self while Neptune sits at the same degree dissolving your ego boundaries — this is your cosmic wake-up call. Meanwhile, your ruler Mars in Capricorn squares this conjunction from your 10th House of Career, demanding you restructure your public image immediately. With Venus in your 3rd House of Communication sextile Jupiter in your 4th House, a conversation with a sibling or neighbor sparks an unexpected romantic introduction — but don't rush commitment while Neptune clouds your judgment. Mars squaring Saturn forces a showdown with authority — a promotion offer comes with strings attached; negotiate the title, not just the salary. Avoid signing binding contracts until Mercury clears its shadow phase next week. Follow for tomorrow's reading when Mercury turns direct and the fog lifts.
